title: Honua SDK established release-matrix lanes v1
description: Reviewed registry of samples whose golden qualification is bound to the release-only cross-browser matrix. Establishment is recorded here, inside the evidence-neutral source digest, precisely because samples/evidence/<sample>/release-matrix.v1.json is not: deleting a sealed receipt must not be able to relax the lane back to unestablished. Absence of this file means no lane has ever been established; an entry means the sidecar receipt is a required qualification input from that point on.

establishedAt.description: Observation time of the FIRST sealed receipt for this lane. Stable once written, so later regenerations produce no source-digest churn.

establishedBy.description: Workflow run identity of that first release smoke.
